messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up 1 we need a consolidated plan for multi-region routing + tenant isolation that we can hand to PMs and Sales. Goal: unstick Q3 commitments.
Ajay Singh: Core options: 1) Soft isolation (shared fabric, quotas, autoscaler rules), 2) Hard isolation (dedicated pools + cryptographic separation). Each has different SLA semantics and cost.
Nora Chen: Customer asks Ive heard: per-tenant egress caps, region pinning for residency, and provable audit trails. Those create routing + infra + compliance workstreams.
Maya Patel: Proposal: define three columns in roadmap: "Baseline" (immediate), "Tiered Isolation" (near-term), "Regulated Profiles" (longer-term). Baseline = better telemetry, eviction policies, cache quotas. Tiered = opt-in dedicated pools. Regulated = HSM/KMS integrations + contractual SLAs.
Samir Rao: Baseline technical checklist: per-tenant cache quota, soft bandwidth caps, eviction circuit-breaker, telemetry hooks (token percentiles, per-route errors), and canary health endpoints. All doable on current fabric with flags.
Ajay Singh: Tiered Isolation checklist: dedicated routing fabric or virtualized fabric with strict network namespaces, billing+quota plumbing, evac/playbook, migration tooling, and perf isolation tests. This likely needs 8-12 weeks engineering.
Nora Chen: Compliance asks map to Regulated Profiles: certified KMS, dedicated capacity by default, audit exportable to SIEMs, and geo-fenced storage. Sales will push customers there but it's a high-touch product.
Maya Patel: Launch criteria suggestion: for Baseline GA: 2-week internal beta, <1% error regressions, documented mitigations for top 3 failure modes, and runbook for auto-evac. For Tiered pilot: slas defined, two pilot customers, perf isolation validated under load.
Samir Rao: Rollout mechanics: feature flags + staged canaries: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25%. Provide automated rollback and fallback to model-variant in another region. Add per-tenant telemetry dashboards.
Ajay Singh: Cost conversation: shared-by-default, dedicated-on-contract. We should model unit economics for small vs large tenants and capture pricing assumptions in the roadmap doc.
Nora Chen: Action items: Maya to draft the three-column roadmap doc and launch criteria; Samir to prototype cache quota enforcement and run perf sims; Ajay to create cost model; Nora to list customers likely to require regulated profile.
Maya Patel: Timeline: draft to PMs by Friday, pilot-ready baseline infra in 6 weeks. Please ack or add blockers. :thumbsup:
Ajay Singh: ack.
Nora Chen: ack, will start compliance intake.
Samir Rao: ack, spinning up sims now; will post results here.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: routing-canary job started at 1901112450.
Maya Patel: Thanks all 1 keep any customer-specific exceptions in this thread so we can fold into the pilot requirements.
